atoms.name: Substitution and cancelling
atoms.one_line: Substitute first; if $0/0$, factor and cancel.

atoms.name: Rationalising
atoms.one_line: Multiply by the conjugate to remove $\sqrt{\,}$ differences.

atoms.name: Limits at infinity
atoms.one_line: Dominant term; growth order $\ln x\ll x^n\ll e^x$.

atoms.name: One-sided limits
atoms.one_line: Limit exists iff left and right limits agree.

atoms.name: Continuity
atoms.one_line: $\lim_{x\to a}f(x)=f(a)$; match pieces at the join.

atoms.name: Differentiability
atoms.one_line: Limit of the difference quotient; kinks fail; differentiable implies continuous.

atoms.name: Squeeze theorem
atoms.one_line: Bounded times vanishing tends to zero.

atoms.name: Algebra of differentiable functions
atoms.one_line: Sums, products, compositions keep differentiability; quotients need a non-zero denominator.
